copy_basis: Task names from the authenticated document coverage table; concise English briefs from those names and inspection of supplied video frames. Detailed per-level thresholds have not been imported.

cases.title: Object-Code Keypad Entry
cases.summary: Remember object–digit associations, decode a visible object sequence, and enter the corresponding code.
cases.instruction: Observe and remember the object–digit pairs. After the display changes, read the object sequence from left to right and enter its digits on the keypad, pressing and releasing each key in order.

cases.title: Color-Block Trial Ordering
cases.summary: Use feedback from trial arrangements to determine the required order of colored blocks.
cases.instruction: Arrange the colored blocks, inspect the displayed feedback, and revise the ordering until the required arrangement is reached.

cases.title: Steamer Stack Order Reconstruction
cases.summary: Remember a stack arrangement and reconstruct the order of the steamer components.
cases.instruction: Observe the initial steamer arrangement, retain its order, and reconstruct the stack after the reference is no longer available.

cases.title: Hidden-Zone Navigation
cases.summary: Remember hidden restricted cells and guide a marker across the grid toward the goal.
cases.instruction: Observe the restricted cells when they are shown. Use the movement controls to guide the marker to the goal while avoiding the remembered restricted areas.

cases.title: Memory Card Matching
cases.summary: Remember revealed card identities and locations to find matching pairs.
cases.instruction: Reveal cards, remember their identities and positions, and use that history to select matching pairs.

cases.title_zh: 方巾折边对齐与稳定落放
cases.title: Cloth Edge Alignment and Placement
cases.summary: Fold and align a cloth edge, then release it in a stable placement.
cases.instruction: Manipulate the cloth to align the required edges, complete the fold, and release the cloth onto the support surface.

cases.title: Oriented Stamp Placement
cases.summary: Orient a stamp and press it onto the designated area.
cases.instruction: Grasp the stamp, align its orientation with the indicated reference, press it onto the target area, and lift it away.

cases.title: Domino Chain Bell Ringing
cases.summary: Arrange dominoes into a chain that carries a falling motion to the bell.
cases.instruction: Place the dominoes along the indicated route, then initiate the chain so that the final action reaches the bell.

cases.title_zh: 周期挡门穿越与及时撤离
cases.title: Periodic Gate Crossing and Withdrawal
cases.summary: Time the arm’s movement through a periodically moving gate and withdraw safely.
cases.instruction: Observe the gate cycle, move through the opening to reach the target, and withdraw before the gate obstructs the passage.

cases.title_zh: 托盘带球搬运与稳定落放
cases.title: Ball-on-Tray Transport and Placement
cases.summary: Carry a tray with a ball while controlling tilt, then place it on the destination surface.
cases.instruction: Lift and transport the tray while keeping the ball supported. Lower the tray onto the destination surface and release it stably.

cases.title: Produce Weighing and Balancing
cases.summary: Use the balance scale’s feedback to select and adjust counterweights for produce.
cases.instruction: Place the produce on the scale, observe its balance, and adjust the counterweights in response to the scale’s feedback.

cases.title: Bridge Construction
cases.summary: Construct a bridge across a gap using the available building pieces.
cases.instruction: Select and position the bridge pieces to connect the two sides of the gap, coordinating the construction sequence with the structure already in place.

cases.title: Reference-Guided Block Construction
cases.summary: Remember a reference structure and reproduce it with the available blocks.
cases.instruction: Observe the reference structure, retain the arrangement, and place the blocks to recreate it after the reference is hidden.

cases.title: Whiteboard Drawing Reconstruction
cases.summary: Recreate a reference drawing on a whiteboard using the available markers.
cases.instruction: Observe the reference drawing and reproduce its shapes and layout on the whiteboard, selecting and manipulating the required markers.

cases.title: Predictive Ball Return and Red-Ball Avoidance
cases.summary: Predict incoming ball motion, return target balls, and avoid red balls.
cases.instruction: Track the incoming balls and time the paddle to return target balls while avoiding contact with red balls.
